name: CoCanvas
description:
Initial release of the CoCanvas plugin for Claude.

Connect Claude to your CoCanvas workspace and ask about your own projects: status updates, rooms and their product and paint selections, moodboards, tasks, products, vendors, clients, RFQs and purchase orders. Claude can also do work for you inside CoCanvas: create an editable moodboard from a room's current selections, add tasks, notes and products, save files into the AI Assistant folder, and draft purchase orders or invoices that you review and send yourself.

You choose what Claude can reach when you connect ("Look things up" and, optionally, "Draft and add things"), and you can narrow or disconnect it at any time from Settings → AI assistants. Financial data (invoices, payments, budgets, balances) is not available to assistants in this release. Claude can never send invoices or purchase orders, record or refund payments, message clients or vendors, delete anything, or change your team, billing or integrations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CoCanvas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CoCanvas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cocanvas.studio/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CoCanvas MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CoCanvas lists 34 MCP tools, including add_product, add_project_note, attach_product_to_project, create_draft_invoice, create_draft_po, create_room_board, create_task, edit_draft_invoice, edit_draft_po, explain_unavailable_action, fetch, and finalize_upload.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CoCanvas?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CoCanvas in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
CoCanvas requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CoCanvas is developed by Planory LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
